NSCameraUsageDescription: Kandro uses the camera to photograph your meal and estimate nutrition. The original photo is discarded after analysis and is not stored.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kandro uses the meal photo you choose to estimate its nutrition.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kandro uses the microphone only while you dictate a meal. Audio is not stored.
NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Kandro turns your spoken meal into text with Apple speech recognition. No recording is stored.
